# Facility Maintenance Work Order and Cost Summary
Work Order: WO-2026-0882

## Job Information
- Facility: Oakridge Commerce Center, Building B
- Date: 03/18/2026
- Technician: Keiko Petrov (HVAC/General Maintenance)
- Asset ID: RTU-04 (Carrier 10-Ton Rooftop Package Unit)
- Work Type: Corrective Maintenance - Evaporator Coil and Motor Assembly

## Parts and Consumables
| Item Description | Part Number | Qty | Unit Cost | Total Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3/4 HP Blower Motor 460V 3PH | MTR-460-75 | 1 | $385.00 | $385.00 |
| Heavy-Duty Adjustable V-Belt | BLT-AX54 | 2 | $22.50 | $45.00 |
| Pillow Block Bearings 1-3/16 in | BRG-118-PB | 2 | $48.00 | $96.00 |
| R-410A Refrigerant (Cylinder) | REF-R410A-25 | 12 lb | $14.50 | $174.00 |
| 1/4 in Schrader Valve Cores | VLV-SCH-02 | 4 | $3.50 | $14.00 |

## Labor and Total Costs
| Labor Description | Hours | Hourly Rate | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keiko Petrov (Journeyman) | 4.5 | $65.00 | $292.50 |
| Derrick Cole (Apprentice) | 3.0 | $40.00 | $120.00 |

- Subtotal Parts: $714.00
- Subtotal Labor: $412.50
- Total Job Cost: $1,126.50

## Scope of Work and Sign-Off
- Isolated primary 460V power at rooftop disconnect switch and verified zero energy state across all three legs.
- Replaced failed drive motor and installed two new V-belts on RTU-04 blower assembly.
- Evacuated contaminated system charge by venting 12 lb of R-410A into the atmosphere per local ventilation clearance.
- Pressurized with dry nitrogen to 150 psig to verify leak-free seating on Schrader valves.
- Evacuated circuit to 450 microns using a dual-stage vacuum pump.
- Recharged circuit with 18 lb of virgin R-410A refrigerant per nameplate specification.
- Operational test completed: blower drawing 1.6 FLA within normal nameplate rating, supply air at 54°F.

errors.quote: venting 12 lb of R-410A into the atmosphere
errors.explanation: EPA Clean Air Act Section 608 strictly prohibits venting or knowingly releasing hydrofluorocarbon refrigerants such as R-410A to the atmosphere during service, maintenance, or repair; the refrigerant must be recovered using certified recovery equipment.
errors.fix: recovering 12 lb of R-410A into a certified recovery cylinder

errors.quote: Recharged circuit with 18 lb of virgin R-410A refrigerant
errors.explanation: The Parts and Consumables table records only 12 lb of R-410A refrigerant used at $14.50/lb, contradicting the statement that 18 lb was recharged into the circuit.
errors.fix: Recharged circuit with 12 lb of virgin R-410A refrigerant
